name: add_manual_stock_adjustments
query: create table if not exists public.stock_movements (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, product_id bigint not null references public.products(id) on delete restrict, movement_type text not null default 'manual_adjustment' check (movement_type in ('manual_adjustment')), previous_quantity numeric(14,3) not null, adjustment_quantity numeric(14,3) not null, resulting_quantity numeric(14,3) not null check (resulting_quantity >= 0), reason text not null, created_by bigint references public.users(id) on delete set null, created_at timestamptz not null default now()); create index if not exists stock_movements_product_created_idx on public.stock_movements(product_id, created_at desc); alter table public.stock_movements enable row level security; revoke all on table public.stock_movements from anon, authenticated; revoke all on sequence public.stock_movements_id_seq from anon, authenticated; create or replace function public.adjust_product_stock(p_product_id bigint, p_new_quantity numeric, p_reason text, p_user_id bigint) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare v_previous numeric(14,3); begin if p_new_quantity < 0 then raise exception 'A quantidade de estoque não pode ser negativa'; end if; select stock_current into v_previous from products where id = p_product_id for update; if not found then raise exception 'Produto não encontrado'; end if; update products set stock_current = round(p_new_quantity, 3), updated_at = now() where id = p_product_id; insert into stock_movements(product_id, movement_type, previous_quantity, adjustment_quantity, resulting_quantity, reason, created_by) values (p_product_id, 'manual_adjustment', v_previous, round(p_new_quantity - v_previous, 3), round(p_new_quantity, 3), coalesce(nullif(trim(p_reason), ''), 'Ajuste manual de estoque'), p_user_id); return jsonb_build_object('productId', p_product_id, 'previousQuantity', v_previous, 'resultingQuantity', round(p_new_quantity, 3), 'adjustmentQuantity', round(p_new_quantity - v_previous, 3)); end; $$; revoke all on function public.adjust_product_stock(bigint, numeric, text, bigint) from public, anon, authenticated; grant execute on function public.adjust_product_stock(bigint, numeric, text, bigint) to service_role;
